title: Rilevazione flusso veicoli tramite spire - anno 2024 (Comune di Bologna open data, hourly road-loop vehicle counts, 2024)
summary: Open-data landing page for hourly vehicle counts from road loop counters ("spire") in the city of Bologna, Italy, for calendar year 2024, with geographic position of each loop. The page describes the counter identifier (codice spira) as changing over time, with id_uni linking the same physical loop across changes, and a per-hour accuracy parameter tied to a separate accuracy dataset. This is a different city from the client (Valdena) and covers only 2024, so it is a pipeline test source for traffic counts, not client traffic. Only the landing page was read; no data file was reachable or sampled.

documentation_excerpts: Rilevazione oraria degli autoveicoli tramite spire e loro posizione geografica.
Si evidenzia inoltre che il codice spira può cambiare nel tempo, pertanto è possibile trovare nella stessa posizione geografica più elementi sovrapposti ma che rappresentano la stessa spira.

I dati del traffico per fascia oraria sono caratterizzati da un parametro definito accuratezza che tiene conto dell'eventuale malfunzionamento delle spire e quindi della valutazione errata del traffico rilevato.
quality_notes: Only the landing page was read. No data file, distribution or download link was found (data_links and jsonld_datasets empty), so the file has not been sampled and no row-level values, counts or null patterns are confirmed.
Coverage is calendar 2024 only (per the URL slug and page title). It cannot cover the 2025 part of the production window or any part of the prototype window.

Loop codes change over time: the page says the same physical loop may appear under several codice spira values and several overlapping rows; id_uni links them. Users must not count overlapping rows twice.
Hourly counts carry an accuracy parameter (accuratezza) that flags loop malfunction; the page says it is documented in a separate 2024 accuracy dataset, not yet reviewed.

Licence conflict: the candidate record says CC BY 4.0, but the fetched page shows no licence text (see licence.evidence). Treat licence as unknown until the portal's licence field is read or Legal confirms it. Open-data policy allows prototyping only; production use needs Legal sign-off.

The Valdena wiki page counter_replacement_2024 (last_edited 2024-04-02) concerns Valdena's own road counters, replaced 2024-03-18, which changed direction handling. It does not apply to Bologna loops, but it shows why counter-level breaks must be checked before any traffic series is joined.
Page footer shows 'Last processing' field empty in the captured text, so the last refresh date is unknown.
